title: She Stoops To Conquer By Oliver Goldsmith Easton Press 100 Greatest Books Ever
descriptionText:
This rare collector's edition of "She Stoops To Conquer" by Oliver Goldsmith is a must-have for any literature and fiction enthusiast. The beautiful leather binding and T.M. Cleland's illustrations make this original 1978 printing a true gem. 

The book, published by Easton Press in Norwalk, Connecticut, is a great addition to any collection. It is a unique opportunity to own a piece of literary history. Don't miss out on this chance to own one of the 100 greatest books ever printed.
